name: Excel
description: Spreadsheet basics for analysis. Covers formulas, sorting, filtering, pivot tables and simple charts.

name: Advanced Excel
description: Advanced spreadsheet techniques including lookup functions, Power Query, complex pivot tables and basic macros.

name: Statistics
description: Descriptive statistics, distributions, sampling and confidence intervals needed to interpret data.

name: Probability
description: Probability rules, conditional probability, Bayes theorem and random variables.

name: Linear Algebra
description: Vectors, matrices, linear transformations and decompositions that underpin machine learning methods.

name: Calculus
description: Derivatives, partial derivatives and gradients, used to understand how models are optimized.

name: Jupyter Notebooks
description: Interactive notebooks for combining code, output and notes during analysis.

name: NumPy
description: Python library for fast array computing, vectorized operations and basic linear algebra.

name: Pandas
description: Python library for working with tabular data. Covers DataFrames, filtering, grouping, merging and reshaping.

name: Matplotlib and Seaborn
description: Python plotting libraries for building statistical charts and customizing figures.

name: Data Cleaning
description: Finding and fixing missing values, duplicates, wrong types and inconsistent formats in raw data.

name: Exploratory Data Analysis
description: Summarizing and visualizing a dataset to find patterns, outliers and questions worth testing.

name: Data Visualization
description: Choosing the right chart type and design principles to show data clearly and honestly.

name: Data Storytelling
description: Turning analysis into a clear narrative with visuals so decision makers can act on the findings.

name: Tableau
description: Business intelligence tool for building interactive dashboards and visual analyses from many data sources.

name: Power BI
description: Microsoft business intelligence tool for loading data, modeling it and building reports and dashboards.

name: DAX
description: Formula language for calculated columns and measures in Power BI and Excel data models.

name: R Programming
description: Statistical programming language with strong tools for data manipulation, modeling and plotting.

name: Hypothesis Testing
description: Using t-tests, chi-square tests and p-values to decide whether an observed effect is real.

name: A/B Testing
description: Designing and analyzing controlled experiments to compare product or marketing changes.

name: Machine Learning
description: Core machine learning ideas. Covers supervised and unsupervised learning, model evaluation, overfitting and common algorithms.

name: scikit-learn
description: Python library for classical machine learning, with ready-made models, pipelines and evaluation tools.

name: Feature Engineering
description: Creating and selecting input variables that help models learn, including encoding, scaling and aggregation.

name: Deep Learning
description: Neural networks with many layers. Covers backpropagation, CNNs, RNNs and training techniques.

name: TensorFlow
description: Google deep learning framework with the Keras API for building and deploying neural networks.

name: PyTorch
description: Deep learning framework popular in research and industry, known for its dynamic computation graphs.

name: Natural Language Processing
description: Machine learning on text. Covers tokenization, embeddings, text classification and sequence models.

name: Computer Vision
description: Machine learning on images and video, including classification, detection and segmentation.

name: Transformers and LLMs
description: Transformer architectures and large language models, including attention, pretraining and fine-tuning.

name: LLM App Development
description: Building applications on top of hosted language models. Covers prompting, retrieval-augmented generation and API integration.

name: Time Series Analysis
description: Analyzing and forecasting data ordered in time, including trend, seasonality and ARIMA-style models.

name: PySpark
description: Python API for Apache Spark, used to process large datasets across a cluster.

name: Data Warehousing
description: Designing central analytical stores with star schemas, fact and dimension tables.

name: Data Modeling
description: Structuring data into tables and relationships, including normalization and dimensional models.

name: ETL Pipelines
description: Building pipelines that extract data from sources, transform it and load it into a target store.

name: Apache Airflow
description: Workflow orchestrator for scheduling and monitoring data pipelines defined as Python DAGs.

name: dbt
description: SQL-based transformation tool for building tested, documented analytics models inside a warehouse.

name: Snowflake
description: Cloud data warehouse platform with separated storage and compute, queried with SQL.

name: BigQuery
description: Google Cloud serverless data warehouse for running SQL queries on very large datasets.

name: Apache Kafka
description: Distributed event streaming platform for moving data between systems in real time.

name: MLflow
description: Open-source tool for tracking experiments, packaging models and managing the model lifecycle.

name: MLOps
description: Practices for deploying, monitoring and retraining machine learning models in production.

name: Python
description: General-purpose programming language widely used for scripting, data analysis, automation and web back ends. Covers syntax, data types, functions, modules and common libraries.

name: SQL
description: Language for querying and manipulating relational databases. Covers SELECT, joins, aggregation, subqueries and basic schema design.
